## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh path needs correction before merge because it can erase evidence of edits to tracked files. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh manifest fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, with tests for both helpers.

## Critical
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — When `names` includes an edited tracked file, `refresh_fingerprints` overwrites its stored digest, causing subsequent verification to accept the edit. You assign every supplied name unconditionally, whereas `register_new_files` preserves existing digests. — Refreshing after adding a new file can silently accept changes to tracked files, defeating the manifest’s integrity check.
